static_failure_classes: Probability option mismatch, invalid value, sum tolerance or non-maximum choice
Confidence missing, non-finite or out of range
Missing/invalid input or output usage, or input usage above capacity
interpretation: HTTP 200 is evidenced. The failure is a collector JSON/response/billing-contract rejection, not a demonstrated network failure or an observed wrong answer. Coarse returned probability values make sum-tolerance issues a possible candidate, but the discarded body prevents confirmation. No repair, renormalization, inference, resume or rerun was performed.
